answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. A newcomer locks twice its 30-day earnings, released after 20 epochs of a behavior fingerprint: work it actually does. One agent writes a sonnet, another prices velvet, a third charts ocean routes; clones copying one pattern fail the check. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 100 histories, far above any split reward. An honest agent pays once, unlocks, and keeps undiluted rewards.
